title: AION 2 Tier List: Launch Class Ratings and Roles
description: These launch ratings describe early solo comfort, party contribution and Abyss utility. They are not measurements of current endgame damage. Compare the role and combat loop for your intended activity before changing class.
summary: These launch ratings describe early solo comfort, party contribution and Abyss utility. They are not measurements of current endgame damage. Compare the role and combat loop for your intended activity before changing class.
quickAnswer: In this early launch comparison, Spiritmaster is S+, while Gladiator and Chanter are S. Use it to shortlist classes, then choose the tank, healer, support or damage role your intended activity needs.
